//: EAS Build/Submit profiles. `deploy:mobile:main:<env>` (shared/scripts/deploy/expo.mjs) maps env → profile: dev→development, staging→preview, prod→production. Each profile bakes its EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL (the shared api origin for that env). Fill the placeholder api hosts + the submit credentials, then `eas build`/`eas submit`. Requires `eas login` (or EXPO_TOKEN) + `eas init` (writes extra.eas.projectId in app.config.ts).

ios.//: Fill from your Apple Developer account (App Store Connect app id + team).

android.//: Path to a Google Play service-account JSON key (keep it out of git).
